svg.aria-label: How I work with an AI agent: I steer (spec, plan review, decision records), Claude Code builds (code, tests on real games, measurements), the harness checks (a hook gates every turn, a subagent tries to refute findings, one single read of held-out data). What turned out false is logged for the next session.
